module_summary: Lemmings walker: a 4-state Moore FSM (walk left/right, fall left/right) driven by bump and ground inputs decodes walk/fall outputs.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: Holds WL/WR/FALLL/FALLR; remembers walking direction across falls.

anchors.name: walk_left
anchors.why: Decoded from WL state; indicates walking left.

anchors.name: walk_right
anchors.why: Decoded from WR state; indicates walking right.

anchors.name: aaah
anchors.why: Decoded from either falling state; indicates the lemming is falling.

groups.name: lemming_fsm
groups.description: Next-state logic on ground and bumps selects walk direction or fall state.

groups.name: output_decode
groups.description: Moore decode of state into walk_left, walk_right and aaah outputs.
